actions.action: Inspect roots for rot (firmness, color, smell)
Repot one size larger (2–5 cm wider) into pot with drainage holes in spring/early summer
Optionally divide the clump of plants when repotting
Gently loosen roots and trim any mushy ones
Check pale dots on pot base with a magnifier for insect eggs or scale

reason: The answer identifies the plant as root-bound and recommends repotting one size up, which matches the confirmed fix; saying there is no rush is mild and does not risk real harm.
